# Qidian Watch Bands

> Watch band manufacturer in Shenzhen, China. Custom silicone, TPU, nylon, ceramic, stainless steel and zinc alloy watch bands for brands, importers and independent sellers. No online checkout: enquiries run through WhatsApp or email.

## Facts
- Minimum order: samples from 1 piece; bulk from 10 pieces per colour; new tooling quoted per project
- Sampling: 7-10 working days; bulk production: 15-25 working days
- Lug widths: 16-24 mm, plus moulded connectors for smartwatch and tracker models
- Working in watch accessories since 2013
